title: Yoga, pilates or fitness studio

fields.label: Classes
fields.help: The kinds of class you run, and your weekly timetable: day, time, class, teacher, length, level and how many fit in the room.

fields.label: What a class is like
fields.help: How one of your classes goes from start to finish: the parts and roughly how long each takes. Yoga flow, pilates, or strength intervals.

fields.label: Prices
fields.help: Intro offer, drop-in price, class packs and memberships.

fields.label: First visit
fields.help: What to bring, cancellation rules, changing rooms, the questions new people ask.

writerNotes: The hero runs one class as a clock: six phases fill a ring in order, the effort is traced inside it and a breathing circle sits in the middle. Write the six phases from the brief's description of a class (or a typical class for the discipline): names, captions, breath cues, minutes that run back to back from 0 to class.length, effort 1 to 5 and breaths a minute. class.shape is flow for yoga and pilates, intervals for strength, HIIT or bootcamps; class.done is the word at the end (Namaste for yoga; Done or Well done otherwise); class.size is a typical class size.

timetable: the brief's kinds of class (up to six) and its week (day 0 is Monday). places taken (taken) are only for the demo: set them so most classes have places and one or two are full. space is what a place is called (mat, reformer, spot, bike).

prices.passes: up to three from the brief (an intro offer marked intro), each with price, per (what it gives) and a sentence. prices.calc compares a month: the drop-in price, the class pack (number of classes and price) and the monthly membership, with their names; if the brief lacks one, use the nearest real option and never invent a price.
first: what to bring and the brief's questions and answers about a first visit; never invent policies the brief doesn't give.

hero.title and hero.titleEm: a short two-part headline (four lines at most on a desktop); each section title has an italic second half (titleEm). theme.accent is the studio's colour, deep enough for white button text; theme.wordmarkFit is always "fit".
business.name is set to exactly the name in the brief and cannot be changed; brand.name is how it appears in the nav and the footer (short).
